steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What are you talking about? This isn't how the story goes! You secretly changed my script!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um, but... You really are quite scary...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sigh... All right then. I'll make an exception and let you co-author this with me!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's fine to be scared of OwO the Archdemon. But this is a story about courage.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What do you want to happen next?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: In this world... th-there might be something known as the "candy of courage"!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: If I eat a piece of it, I'll be able to defeat the Archdemon for sure!
